claims.statement: The desktop application utilizes Tauri to bridge a React and TypeScript frontend with Rust backend command handlers, event brokers, and generated TypeScript bindings.
Persistence is implemented via an ACID-compliant SQLite backend supporting versioned migrations, WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, and explicit transaction boundaries.
The persistence layer (`theogony-db-sqlite`) provides an ACID-compliant SQLite backend supporting WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, versioned schema migrations, and transaction management.
Tauri IPC commands bridge the React frontend to Rust backend services, while TypeScript API bindings are automatically generated from Rust types using ts-rs and verified via CI scripts.
The `theogony-app` crate serves as the Tauri shell and desktop application entrypoint, acting as the sole crate aware of all other workspace crates.
Application operations are implemented as plain Rust functions over AppState within `theogony-app/src/commands/` with transport adapters on top.
The frontend user interface is built with React and Fluent UI v9 running inside the Tauri desktop shell.

The persistence layer utilizes ACID-compliant SQLite with WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, migration management, and transaction boundaries wrapped behind repository traits defined in theogony-ports.
Theogony utilizes SQLite with WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, and explicit migration paths as its local-first persistence spine.

Theogony's Rust workspace is structured into eight discrete crates (`theogony-domain`, `theogony-ports`, `theogony-db-sqlite`, `theogony-gedcom`, `theogony-ai`, `theogony-dna`, `theogony-haplogroup`, and `theogony-app`) to enforce separation of concerns between domain logic, persistence, interchange, AI, DNA, haplogroups, and the Tauri desktop shell.

Theogony-domain owns pure domain records, strongly typed identifiers, provenance models, DNA bucketing/relationship/WATO models, and error types with zero external storage or persistence dependencies.
Persistence is implemented via an ACID-compliant SQLite backend supporting versioned schema migrations, WAL mode, foreign key enforcement, hypothesis branching, and explicit transaction boundaries.

Theogony uses a modular Rust workspace architecture with eight specialized crates: theogony-domain, theogony-ports, theogony-db-sqlite, theogony-ai, theogony-gedcom, theogony-dna, theogony-haplogroup, and theogony-app.
theogony-app serves as the Tauri desktop shell and orchestrates all backend crates, plain Rust command handlers over AppState, IPC routing, and TypeScript binding generation via ts-rs.
theogony-domain provides pure domain models, record structs, strongly typed identifiers, DNA bucketing, relationship, WATO, and provenance types with zero external persistence dependencies.
theogony-db-sqlite implements an ACID-compliant SQLite storage spine featuring migration management, versioned schemas, hypothesis branching, and transaction/edit history logs.
theogony-gedcom handles GEDCOM 7 parsing, serialization, and .tgpkg interchange archive packaging.
theogony-dna provides DNA segment mapping, chromosome browser calculations, genetic match bucketing, Y-STR marker analysis, and WATO hypothesis scoring.
theogony-haplogroup performs haplogroup calculations and phylogenetic branch analysis.
theogony-ai provides local and cloud-assisted AI analysis helpers, AI override tracking, and Terms of Service (ToS) state management.
theogony-ports defines trait definitions and repository interfaces mediating between application logic and storage/service implementations.
The frontend desktop UI is built with React and TypeScript, communicating with the Tauri backend via IPC invoke and commands.
